text: {"observations":"Speech bursts sit at about 1.5-2.5 s, 3.25-5.25 s and 6.25-8.5 s, where noisiness drops to 0-3 against a noisy background. In voiced stretches the f0 estimate clusters around 175-225 Hz (e.g. 187 Hz at 8.0-8.4 s, 192-223 Hz at 6.3-7.0 s), though salience is low. At 8.0-8.4 s the spectral peaks at ~374, 559, 750 and 931 Hz are spaced ~187 Hz apart, consistent with a ~187 Hz fundamental. The pitch varies naturally between bursts rather than staying flat, which argues against a robot. That range is too high for a typical man (~85-155 Hz) and below a typical child (~250-400 Hz), and fits an adult woman.","answer":"A"}
